notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[u]Additional Stages[/u]
A new stage has been added. This stage has an eerie atmosphere.

notes.title: 2023/6/24 Update record
notes.content:
[u]Fixing Defects[/u]
Fixed a problem where data could not be reset via Options > Reset.

notes.title: May 27, 2023 Update record
notes.content:
[u]Changes[/u]
・Added "Quality Settings" to Options > Video.
・Added "Frame Rate Limit" to Options > Video.
・Some changes were made to the text of the manual.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[u]Added high difficulty mode[/u]
The difficulty level can be switched in the stage selection menu.
The difficulty level for conventional games is "Normal".

notes.title: May 12, 2023 Update record
notes.content:
[u]Changes[/u]
・Change the name of "Resolution Scale" to "Picture Quality" in　Options>Video
The content remains the same, just the name has been changed.
Also, the default setting for image quality has been set to 50.
This is to prevent the game from being too heavy to start.
If you feel that the images have become coarse after the update, please set the image quality to a level appropriate for your PC.

・Added text to some stage clear screens

[u]Fixing Defects[/u]
・Bug with some enemies not moving.
